sentences.text: The allegation against the applicants is that of selling substandard Pan Masala, which was being sold in the name of "Pan Bahar Khandani Pan Masala".

Counsel for the applicants has submitted that the aforesaid product was purchased by the applicants from some other person; and in fact, its manufacture is at New Delhi only and address of which has also been furnished to the respondent / Food Department and a notice under Rule 2.4.2 (6) of Food Safety and Standard Rules 2011 has also been issued to the said manufacturer including the present applicants.

Counsel has also submitted that even according to the Police Prativedan, the statements of the applicants have also been recorded by the prosecution / Food Department and at this juncture, their custodial interrogation is not necessary, as the charge sheet is about to be filed, as no further recovery or discovery is to be made at their instance.
It is further submitted that the applicants were given a notice under Section 41-A of the Cr.P.C.
It is submitted that in case of their arrest, an irreparable injury shall be caused to their reputation.
Counsel has submitted that even otherwise, the applicant (s) is ready to cooperate with the investigation and no purpose would be served in sending the applicant (s) behind the bars.
Thus, it is submitted that the applicant (s) be released on anticipatory bail.
Counsel for the respondent / State, on the other hand, has opposed the prayer.

Having heard counsel for the parties and on perusal of the case diary as also the documents filed by the applicants on record, this Court finds it expedient to allow the present anticipatory bail application, as the custodial interrogation of the applicant (s) does not appear necessary.
Accordingly, the application stands allowed.

It is directed that in the event of arrest, applicant No.1 Lokesh S/o Mangilal Patidar and applicant No.2 Jitendra S/o Ramesh Chandra Soni shall be released on bail, upon each of them executing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (rupees twenty five thousand only) and furnishing solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer (Investigating Officer).
The applicant (s) shall make himself / herself available for interrogation by a Police Officer, as and when required.
He / she shall further abide by the other conditions enumerated in Sub Section (2) of Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.

It is made clear that, after being released on bail, if the applicant (s) again indulges himself / herself in any criminal activity, the present bail order shall stand cancelled without further reference to the Court and the police shall be entitled to arrest the applicant (s) in the present case also.
Accordingly, Miscellaneous Criminal Case No.23947/2022 stands allowed.
